sections.heading: Core model
sections.content: Go is statically typed and gives every variable a zero value. Short declaration `:=` is for function bodies and must introduce at least one new name. Numeric conversions are explicit and may still lose range or precision, so validate before converting. `strconv.Atoi` and related functions return a value and an error. Handle the error before using the value; do not discard it merely to shorten code. Wrap errors with `%w` when adding context so callers can inspect the original cause. Reserve panics for unrecoverable programmer or initialization failures, not normal invalid input.
